notes.problem: Mannequin sleeve with a doll hand pointing; the sheet overhangs the edge into the void.
notes.fix: Tight crop of two hands on the keyboard, sleeves cut at the wrist, the sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow.

notes.problem: Peg-fingered hand, a zero thickness sheet floating over the edge, a mid grey sleeve filling the right third.
notes.fix: Both hands on the keys cropped at the wrist, a dark sleeve, the sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow.

notes.problem: Pale tube sleeve, mitten hand, sheet floating at an angle.
notes.fix: Sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow, the sleeve darkened, the hand at the keys the one lit thing.

notes.problem: Low poly faceless figures read as game NPCs; the hero desk cropped and flat lit.
notes.fix: Remove the figures; empty chairs raked by the window's last light toward the lectern; the hero's lid the only practical.

notes.problem: Game character figures, cropped right-hand figures, a black chair-back block in the lower left.
notes.fix: Camera up and right of the hero desk so its lit top replaces the block; rows rim lit from the window as silhouettes.

notes.problem: Kit mannequins with a white clip on every collar, a black chair slab in the lower left, the room in a grey mid dark.
notes.fix: Figures as silhouettes against the window's light, camera low behind the hero desk, the near chair out of frame.

notes.problem: Mannequin walker with a smeared head, feet straddling the paver edge.
notes.fix: Drop the figure; a single long cast shadow of an off-frame person across the pavers toward the desk.

notes.problem: The low detail walker is the biggest light mass; the lawn evenly lit.
notes.fix: The desk and its paver the only pool; the walker in near silhouette with a west rim and a long shadow.

notes.problem: A stiff mannequin walker on the grass beside the walk, the desk small behind her.
notes.fix: Crop the walker to a back lit shoulder from the left with feet on the near paver, the desk a third of the frame height.

notes.problem: Laptop on a blown white top against a navy void; a 21 px title.
notes.fix: Camera back to eye 1.0 m with the lawn and seam beyond the lid; desk top exposure down; title at 24 px or larger.

notes.problem: A square-on product shot; the desk top brighter than the page; a stray arc in the bottom band.
notes.fix: Rake the key so the top falls off; crop upward so the bottom band leaves the frame.

notes.problem: Middle screens alias; right columns off the frame.
notes.fix: Far screens toward black with distance; pull back so all rows sit inside with a dark margin.

notes.problem: Desk small at the left; flat lawn of repeated tufts; labels unanchored.
notes.fix: Camera along the walk so the desk stands at the right third; leader ticks to the inlays.
